reason: The company received a show cause cum demand notice from the Office of the Commissioner CGST and Central Excise Commissionerate, Belapur, which threatens cash flows and margins through potential tax penalties.
why_now: The regulatory demand notice was officially disclosed in an exchange filing on September 6, 2026, presenting an immediate negative catalyst.
source_headlines: Neogen Chemicals Limited: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of show cause cum demand notice from the Office of the Commissioner CGST and Central Excise Commissionerate, Belapur.
